description: This file declares functions and constants related to object ID handling in Git, including parsing hex strings into object IDs and determining hash algorithms based on environment variables.

methods.name: cl_parse_any_oid
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object_id, generating a SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash based on the environment configuration.

methods.name: cl_setup_hash_algo
methods.description: Determines the hash algorithm used by consulting the GIT_TEST_DEFAULT_HASH environment variable, defaulting to SHA-1.
